- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: “comments carrying an automation marker (`<!-- ai:… -->`)” as a class that “must never trigger”
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/clarify.yml:21`, `.github/workflows/internal-clarify.yml:17`, `workflow-templates/ai-clarify.yml:17`; job `if:` clause
  Evidence of absence: The implementation only excludes marker comments when the command is on a later line; tests and supporting classifiers intentionally preserve first-line behavior.
  Problem: First-line `/reclarify` followed by an `<!-- ai:` marker still triggers clarification.
  Why it fails at runtime: an automation comment that begins with `/reclarify` and includes `<!-- ai:… -->` restarts clarification even though the issue asked for it to never trigger. Two existing automated flows rely on that behavior, so the deviation is deliberate and documented in the editor's prior summary.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
